model.title: A resolution honoring the life and legacy of Dolly Parton, a daughter of Tennessee whose extraordinary contributions to music, philanthropy, literacy, education, health, conservation, and culture enriched the lives of countless Americans.

summary.text: The resolution honors country music legend Dolly Parton for her lifetime of contributions to music, charitable giving, literacy programs, education, healthcare, environmental conservation, and American culture. It recognizes how her work has positively affected the lives of people across the United States.
